decisions.reason: The product has had two years of visible market presence and its own page, suggesting enough value to keep the option open while black bathroom demand remains uncertain but low-cost to maintain.
It has been consistently supported since 2023 and aligns with core drainage competence, so the firm should keep this option as uncertainty resolves without much extra cost.

It is only one year old and its pump-drain niche is still uncertain, especially given the earlier pump-assisted product was dropped, but the low cost of keeping it justifies one more year to see if it gains traction.
